TRAP worth repo-wide attention: typeCheckErrors is a compile-time macro and sbt's incremental compiler does NOT recompile a probe suite when only the probed type's shape or visibility changes -- both mutants first read as SURVIVED and both die under corpusJVM/clean. Every mutation run against a forge probe in this repo must clean the test scope first. This likely affects the 21 existing construction-boundary suites (see bd-01M1836WDBB72KXXPKG23PSSWT).
